title: A Language Goes Extinct Every 2 Weeks
hook: One language disappears about every 2 weeks.
closing: Every lost language erases knowledge that cannot be translated back.
question: Which languages do you speak?

segments.say: About 40% of languages are endangered or dying. Their final speakers carry entire systems of knowledge.
The loss rate now reaches 26 languages a year. Communities are falling silent far faster than before.
Only 3,500 languages may remain by 2100. Half of today's linguistic diversity could disappear.
